Class DoubleEngine

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Engine
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.DoubleEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class DoubleEngine extends Engine
Represents a double engine tile on the ship board. A double engine provides double movement strength (2 units), and its functionality is directional.
